newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen's Saleh urges more security ahead of poll.
newsitem.headline: Yemen's Saleh urges more security ahead of poll.

text.p: Yemeni President Ali Abdullah Saleh on Saturday called on the interior ministry to beef up security measures ahead of parliamentary elections in April.
"We urge everyone at the ministry of interior to be more alert...to further enhance security and stability," he said.
"Election day is coming (on April 27) and there's no doubt each great accomplishment faces those who reject it...There are bad members of personnel who try to affect public security," Saleh said.
An official source at the ministry of interior said Friday's kidnapping of four German tourists in Yemen aimed at damaging the country's reputation and preparations for the elections.

In recent years, Yemeni tribes with grievances against the government or foreign oil firms have kidnapped scores of tourists, diplomats or other foreigners to use as bargaining chips. The hostages have all been released unharmed.
